audit_findings: The root probability Markov inequality is unrelated to polynomial Markov derivative bounds.
No published root item supplies the finite-grid Ehlich–Zeller derivative step; QA15 retains a local lemma with an explicit grid-return sublemma.

The published strict point-versus-closed-convex separation theorem is finite-dimensional and usable as a separation ingredient in the QA16 SDP proof, but does not prove Slater, closedness of the chosen image set, strict witnesses, boundedness, or attainment by itself.
QA16 retains explicit primal/dual cones, affine maps, strict witness, boundedness, separation and multiplier-identification obligations.
All algorithms use empty `justified_by`; correctness, success, termination and query complexity live in result rows with the algorithm in their `deps` per SCHEMA §Algorithms.

The final draft inventory has 109 unique items; all direct dependencies resolve against the current QA/QC proposed inventories and published root items. Exact QC-owned reserved interfaces are matched to the QC proposed definitions; canonical central inventory merge remains pending.

QA11 preserves the exact integer-maximizing known-count query algorithm and adds a separate nine-round randomized-iteration variant with integer-binary-search K, an O(n^3) classical bit-cost contract, and QC-explicit reflection gate accounting.
Fixed uniform states in QA11 and the QA13 counting specialization use H^⊗n|0^n⟩ with QC07 H-gate and QC09 elementary-resource suppliers; they do not depend on QC24 amplitude-table state synthesis.
QA13 counting is restricted to N=2^n in this specialization, so the specified n Hadamards prepare the exact uniform state without an unstated arbitrary-N state-preparation routine.
